nodes.title: Monorepo Setup, Toolchain & Shared Configs
nodes.summary: Initialize workspace with TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, strict tsconfig, and shared contract packages.
exit_criteria: Turborepo / workspace compiles cleanly
CI linter and typecheck pass with zero errors

dod_evidence: Commit 477bea0 merged into main with full toolchain tests passing

nodes.title: Postgres Database Models & Automated Migrations
nodes.summary: Implement schema for Tenants, Users, Memberships, Subscriptions, and AuditLogs with automated migration tooling.
exit_criteria: Migrations execute forward and rollback cleanly in CI
Foreign key cascades and indexes on tenant_id verified

dod_evidence: PostgreSQL migration suite 001_initial verified against test container

nodes.title: Redis Cache Cluster & Job Queue Client
nodes.summary: Configure distributed Redis connection pool, key-namespace prefixing by tenant, and BullMQ/Celery job queues.
exit_criteria: Redis cluster reconnects automatically on network drops
Tenant namespace isolation enforced by wrapper client

dod_evidence: Redis connection and queue failover integration tests passed

nodes.title: Multi-Tenant Context & Row-Level Security Policy
nodes.summary: Enforce request tenant context extraction from subdomains/headers and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).
exit_criteria: Cross-tenant data leakage tests pass with 100% rejection
Async storage context correctly propagates tenant ID

dod_evidence: RLS automated penetration and isolation matrix tests green

nodes.title: Structured Logging, Tracing & OpenTelemetry Pipeline
nodes.summary: Configure JSON structured logger with trace_id correlation, OpenTelemetry collector exporters, and Prometheus metrics.
exit_criteria: Traces include tenant_id and request_id tags
/metrics endpoint exposes standard HTTP and worker metrics

dod_evidence: OTel span export and JSON log verification tests passed

nodes.title: Authentication Service (JWT, WebAuthn & Refresh Rotations)
nodes.summary: Implement user signup, login, password hashing (argon2id), WebAuthn passkeys, and secure refresh token rotation.
exit_criteria: Brute force protection and rate limiting verified
Token revocation and refresh rotation tested against replay attacks

dod_evidence: AuthN suite with 100% test coverage and replay defense verified

nodes.title: Multi-Tenant RBAC & Fine-Grained Permission Engine
nodes.summary: Implement Owner, Admin, Member, and Viewer roles with custom permission matrices evaluated per tenant organization.
exit_criteria: Permission evaluation resolves in < 2ms
Unauthorized role actions return RFC 7807 403 Forbidden

nodes.title: Enterprise SSO & SAML 2.0 / Okta Integration
nodes.summary: Enable enterprise tenants to configure SAML 2.0 / OIDC Identity Providers with Just-In-Time (JIT) user provisioning.
exit_criteria: Okta and Azure AD metadata auto-discovery verified
Enforced SSO domain-based login redirects

nodes.title: Immutable Audit Log & Security Event Streaming
nodes.summary: Cryptographically chained audit trail for all write operations, security changes, and credential mutations.
exit_criteria: Audit event ledger hashes verify sequentially without tamper
Export audit logs as SIEM-compatible JSONL

nodes.title: Scoped API Keys & Developer Service Tokens
nodes.summary: Generate high-entropy API keys (`cp_live_...`) with SHA-256 hash storage, permission scopes, and expiration policies.
exit_criteria: Plaintext key presented only once at creation
Key usage updates last_used_at timestamp asynchronously

nodes.title: Public REST & OpenAPI Gateway
nodes.summary: Build the core HTTP REST API endpoints with automated OpenAPI 3.1 contract generation and Zod validation.
exit_criteria: All routes documented in generated openapi.json
Payload validation errors return RFC 7807 problem details

nodes.title: Distributed Background Worker Train & Scheduling Engine
nodes.summary: Deploy scalable background worker processes for async tasks, cron recurrence, retry backoffs, and dead-letter queues.
exit_criteria: Workers consume tasks idempotently with job locks
Dead-letter alerts triggered on unrecoverable failures

nodes.title: Real-Time WebSocket & Server-Sent Events (SSE) Bus
nodes.summary: Implement pub/sub event broadcasting over WebSockets and SSE with Redis adapter across clustered nodes.
exit_criteria: 10,000 concurrent connections benchmarked under < 50ms latency
Tenant-scoped room authorization checked on handshake

nodes.title: Outbound Webhooks Delivery Engine with HMAC Signatures
nodes.summary: Deliver outbound webhook notifications with HMAC-SHA256 signatures, exponential backoff retries, and delivery status logs.
exit_criteria: Signature header `X-CloudPulse-Signature` verified
Endpoints failing 50 times auto-disabled with owner notification

nodes.title: Distributed Rate Limiting & Sliding Window Throttler
nodes.summary: Implement Redis sliding-window token bucket algorithm to enforce per-IP, per-user, and per-tenant tier rate limits.
exit_criteria: Headers `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` returned
Excess requests return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests

nodes.title: Stripe Billing Engine, Checkout & Webhook Handlers
nodes.summary: Integrate Stripe Checkout, Customer Portal, payment method management, and idempotent subscription webhook handling.
exit_criteria: Handled events: `customer.subscription.created`, `invoice.payment_succeeded`, `invoice.payment_failed`
Duplicate webhook deliveries processed idempotently

nodes.title: Usage-Based Metering & Aggregate Ingestion Pipeline
nodes.summary: Track high-throughput API calls and event volume per tenant, batch aggregating hourly for Stripe metered billing sync.
exit_criteria: Hourly aggregation crons run without missing counts
Tenant usage overage recorded and submitted to Stripe Metered API

nodes.title: Subscription Tier Gating & Feature Flag System
nodes.summary: Entitlement check middleware enabling features (Free, Pro, Enterprise) dynamically based on active subscription tier.
exit_criteria: Feature access denied with upgrade prompt when plan insufficient
Grandfathered features override enabled per tenant

nodes.title: Frontend App Shell & SIGNAL Design System Theme Tokens
nodes.summary: Build Next.js / Vite SPA with SIGNAL Design System tokens (`#0A0B08`, `#CBF23F`), responsive layout, and topbar navigation.
exit_criteria: No UI flash during load, full dark mode theme token compliance
Mobile and desktop responsive breakpoints validated

dod_evidence: SIGNAL design system components build green with 100% token conformance

nodes.title: Organization Onboarding & Team Invitation Flow
nodes.summary: Implement first-time user organization creation wizard and email invitation flow for team collaborators.
exit_criteria: Invited members join with designated RBAC role
Onboarding step persistence validated on refresh

nodes.title: Real-Time Telemetry Dashboard & Live Metrics UI
nodes.summary: Interactive analytics charts, live event stream terminal, latency histograms, and status indicators.
exit_criteria: Real-time chart updates without DOM memory leaks
Empty states and error boundaries rendered gracefully

nodes.title: API Key & Webhook Management UI Portal
nodes.summary: Developer settings screen to generate/revoke API keys, configure webhook endpoints, and inspect delivery logs.
exit_criteria: Masked key reveal with 1-click clipboard copy
Recent webhook deliveries with HTTP status code badges and retry button

nodes.title: Billing & Usage Management UI Dashboard
nodes.summary: Subscription tier card selector, current billing cycle usage meter, invoice history download, and Stripe portal link.
exit_criteria: Plan upgrade dialog redirects seamlessly to Stripe Checkout
Quota progress bars show exact percentages and renewal date

nodes.title: Docker Multi-Stage Build & Local Compose Rig
nodes.summary: Create hardened multi-stage distroless Docker images for API and Workers with rootless user execution.
exit_criteria: Image size < 120MB with zero critical CVEs in Trivy scan
`docker compose up` starts full stack locally in < 30s

dod_evidence: Docker images built and Trivy vulnerability scan green

nodes.title: Terraform Infrastructure as Code (AWS ECS, RDS & ElastiCache)
nodes.summary: Declarative Terraform modules for VPC, Private Subnets, RDS Postgres Multi-AZ, ElastiCache Redis, and ECS Fargate.
exit_criteria: `terraform plan` succeeds with zero drift against state
No public database access; all ingress routed through ALB with SSL

dod_evidence: Terraform plan and security group boundary tests green

nodes.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline with Matrix Testing
nodes.summary: Continuous Integration running lint, unit tests, mutation tests, Playwright E2E, and automated Docker registry push.
exit_criteria: All checks pass under 4 minutes with cached node_modules and layers
Branch protection rules enforce green CI before merge

dod_evidence: CI/CD workflow executed and verified on main

nodes.title: Staging Environment Deployment & Smoke Test Pipeline
nodes.summary: Automated deployment to isolated Staging environment with automated database seeding and post-deploy smoke checks.
exit_criteria: Automated healthchecks return 200 OK across all microservices
Synthetic transaction tests pass against staging endpoints

nodes.title: Zero-Downtime Production Rolling Deployment
nodes.summary: Blue/green or rolling zero-downtime deployment mechanism with automated rollback triggers on 5xx error spikes.
exit_criteria: Zero dropped HTTP requests during rolling container upgrade
Rollback triggered if error rate exceeds 0.5% within 5 minutes

nodes.title: Disaster Recovery, Automated Backups & Failover Drill
nodes.summary: Point-in-time recovery (PITR) for PostgreSQL and automated cross-region snapshot replication with verified restore drill.
exit_criteria: RPO < 5 minutes and RTO < 30 minutes proven in simulated outage
Encrypted backup integrity validated daily via automated worker

nodes.title: SOC2 Type II Audit Readiness & Continuous Compliance Engine
nodes.summary: Collect continuous automated evidence for access controls, encryption at rest/in transit, and vulnerability management.
exit_criteria: Automated daily compliance checks green
Auditor evidence export package generated without manual intervention

nodes.title: Transactional Email Service with React Email Templates
nodes.summary: Deliver transactional emails (welcome, invite, password reset, usage alerts) with React Email templates via Postmark / Resend.
exit_criteria: DKIM, SPF and DMARC verification verified green
Email bounce webhook handler updates user deliverability status

nodes.title: Product Analytics & Event Ingestion Pipeline
nodes.summary: Privacy-first event tracking (PostHog / Mixpanel) with anonymized user IDs, funnel tracking, and retention cohorts.
exit_criteria: Cookie consent respected with strict GDPR opt-out mode
Core activation funnel tracked from signup to first API query

nodes.title: In-App Notification Center & Changelog Banner
nodes.summary: Real-time notification bell dropdown for system alerts, invite acceptances, and interactive product update banners.
exit_criteria: Unread badge count updates dynamically over WebSockets
Mark all as read updates state in DB immediately
